title: A Nightingale Sang in Berkeley Square (E♭ major)

details.title: A Nightingale Sang in Berkeley Square
details.lead: Manning Sherwin and Eric Maschwitz, 1940. The chorus as written, with its last ending, checked bar by bar against Rod Stewart's record; where Rod sings it his own way, the written tune is kept. The middle part moves to G major and back.
